verdict.rationale: Docs show data is created/queried via Arrow tables (e.g. arrow.Field, table.search) and LanceDB can directly scan Lance datasets via hf:// URIs on Hugging Face, implying an Arrow/Lance-based interchange format for ingest, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated bulk-import/export workflow (e.g. CSV/Parquet import commands, export utilities) for vectors plus metadata. missing for 10: explicit bulk-export documentation, explicit bulk-import CLI/API examples, named supported file formats (CSV/Parquet/JSON) beyond Arrow/Lance, independent corroboration of import/export usage.
